features.name: short_word_share_oc
features.definition: What proportion of all words across the counter-argument comments are short words (three letters or fewer)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings (malformed/missing -> null). Concatenate all comments' text. Tokenize words with re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)*", text.lower()). A short word is a token whose letters (excluding apostrophes) number at most 3. Value = short tokens / total tokens pooled across all comments (not mean of per-comment shares). Empty list or zero tokens -> null. Raw mechanical text count; no semantic filtering.

h0: short_word_share_oc has no association with delta (coefficient = 0).
h1: Higher short_word_share_oc is associated with a lower probability of delta (coefficient < 0).
note: Assumptions: "short words" operationalized as tokens of ≤3 letters (threshold not supplied by hypothesis); pooled share across all available counter-argument comments. "Persuasive" is measured by the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view), an association only. OC_comments are raw text and may contain view-change/delta announcements or quoted text; these are not removed. Comment order/timing unknown. Simple vocabulary is only proxied by short word share.
